tldr: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Argon on Sep 30 as its next frontier model. Latent Space framed it a day later as DeepMind's answer to Astra and Fable, with 1M output tokens, but only Fairwind Program users could try it.
whats_new: Gemini 4 Argon reached Google Cloud on Oct 13, and DeepMind the same day published a robotics variant and a post on how it developed Argon responsibly and safely.
why_it_matters: Cloud availability turns Argon from a benchmark-only headline into something you can price and test; the 1M output limit now matters for long agent runs.

status.detail: Announced Sep 30 with restricted access; Google Cloud availability and safety documentation followed Oct 13.

beats.headline: 1M output, but access limited to Fairwind Program users
Argon reaches Google Cloud; robotics variant and safety write-up follow

open_questions: What pricing and rate limits apply to Gemini 4 Argon on Google Cloud?
What do independent evals show against Astra and Fable?
Is Gemini 4 Argon for Robotics available outside DeepMind partners?
take_for_builders: Run a small eval of Argon on Google Cloud against your pinned Gemini model and record cost per completed task before changing any default.
